summary: Cybin Inc., doing business as Helus Pharma, filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing the closing of a previously disclosed US$50 million underwritten offering of 10,309,280 common shares at US$4.85 per share. Cantor and Barclays acted as joint bookrunning managers; a US$3 million cash commission was paid. Net proceeds will fund clinical programs (HLP003, HLP004, HLP005) and working capital. This is a standard equity capital raise under an existing shelf registration, not a special situation. No premium, activist, M&A, or restructuring elements are present.
